contract: POST /api/ask, legacy wire contract v1 (functions/api/ask.ts @ bb057a7)

evidence.observed-live: Probed against https://docs.apertis.ai/api/ask (Pages deployment 2efbe4c4, source bb057a7) on 2026-09-29 with requests that stop before Jina/Supabase/Apertis. No paid call, database write or customer credential was used.
evidence.source-derived: Read from functions/api/ask.ts and src/components/UnifiedSearchModal/AskAITab.tsx; not exercised against real services under #5.

body.question: string, required, 1..2000 characters
body.turnstileToken: string, required, one-shot Turnstile token (site key 0x4AAAAAACS2SzpYBFytHb_E, invisible widget)
body.pageContext: optional {title: string, href: string}; server collapses whitespace in title, trims it and cuts it to 120 chars, trims href and cuts it to 240 chars, and drops the whole object when either field is not a string, the title is empty, or href does not start with '/' or starts with '//'

cases.name: missing-server-bindings
cases.evidence: observed-live (Pages preview deployment 4c4b01a3 and local wrangler)
cases.note: The environment check runs before validation, so an environment without the seven secrets answers 500 to every POST.

cases.name: get
cases.note: Only onRequestPost/onRequestOptions exist; GET falls through to the static not-found page, not 405.

cases.name: session-limit

json.error: Query limit reached for this session

cases.note: Per-isolate in-memory Map keyed by the client-chosen sessionId; resets on cold start. Not distributed abuse protection.

json.error: Jina API error: <status> | Supabase search error: <message> | Apertis API error: <status> | An error occurred processing your request

cases.name: success-stream
cases.note: Only non-empty choices[0].delta.content deltas are forwarded. Citations are Markdown links [Title](/url-path) inside the text; the client derives source pills from internal links. There is no separate citation frame.

compatibility.legacyClientReads: Lines starting with 'data: '; '[DONE]' ends processing of the current chunk; any JSON frame with a truthy `content` string is appended; frames without `content` and unparseable frames are ignored; HTTP 429 shows a fixed message; any other non-2xx shows the JSON `error`/`details` text.
compatibility.newServerMay: Add response headers and add SSE frames that carry no `content` key, and sanitize 500 bodies to {error, traceId?} without raw provider details. It must keep every request field, status code, 400/403/429 body and content frame above.
compatibility.newClientMust: Work against the legacy server above: treat any additional frame or header as optional and never require it.
